title: VIXEN Text configure requires manual UNDERTOW_ROOT
body: The documented vixen-wsl configure failed at VIXEN/libraries/Text/CMakeLists.txt:5 because UNDERTOW_ROOT was unset. Recovery required exporting UNDERTOW_ROOT=/home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/glyphpair and VIXEN_FETCHCONTENT_CACHE=/home/liory/projects/VBVS--VIXEN/.claude-worktrees/glyphpair/.tmp/fetch before cmake. The project preset should derive or validate these paths and document the queue-safe setup.
